setBonuses.description: (1 item) While Sprinting gain a stack of Draconic Scales every |cffffff0.5|r seconds, granting you 660 Armor, up to 20 stacks max. flavorText: A rare fish found only in the foul waters of High Isle.
name: Systres Flounder

title: Skulltooth Barbel
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the foul waters of High Isle.
name: Skulltooth Barbel

title: Ropefish
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the foul waters of High Isle.
name: Ropefish

title: Coins
flavorText: An assortment of coins. Some are polished while others are tarnished and covered in grit.
name: Coins

title: Pre-Purchase Crown Experience Scroll
abilityDescription: You gain a |cffffff100|r% Experience Point bonus from all sources for |cffffff1|r hour. The timer pauses when you are offline, and resumes when you return.
flavorText: Created by a Priestess of Meridia, for whom time is relative.
name: Pre-Purchase Crown Experience Scroll

title: Fragment of the Fleet Queen's Anchor
flavorText: A rune-scribed, coral-encrusted fragment, prized from the corpse of the late Fleet Queen of the Dreadsail Pirates.
name: Fragment of the Fleet Queen's Anchor

title: Unnerving Noble Portrait
flavorText: An artist's depiction of the Mad Duke Dufort stares disquietingly out at the viewer.
name: Unnerving Noble Portrait

title: Druid Picture Book
flavorText: A child's primer, it features colorful pictures showing young practitioners of the True Way.
name: Druid Picture Book

title: Fetish Knife
flavorText: Cruel barbs ensure this knife doesn't just cut, it hurts.
name: Fetish Knife

title: Spriggan's Veil
flavorText: A branch sometimes shed by spriggans, said to have symbolic meaning in Druidic practices.
name: Spriggan's Veil

title: Felt "Cheese" Scepter
flavorText: A stout piece of oak topped with yellow felt in the shape of a block of cheese.
name: Felt "Cheese" Scepter

title: Raven-feather Scepter
flavorText: A thin piece of willow with a tightly bound bunch of raven feathers at the end.
name: Raven-feather Scepter

title: Obsidian Claw Scepter
flavorText: A piece of obsidian stone carved into a rod with a panther's claw shaped tip.
name: Obsidian Claw Scepter

title: Torn-up Tribute Deck
flavorText: This used to be a beautiful, custom deck of Tribute cards. Apparently its former owner lost one too many games.
name: Torn-up Tribute Deck

title: Roister's Club Cup
flavorText: A slightly chipped cup from the Gonfalon Bay Roister's Club.
name: Roister's Club Cup

title: Roister's Club Tapestry
flavorText: A slightly faded tapestry advertising the Mournhold Roister's Club.
name: Roister's Club Tapestry

title: Jade Tribute Dice
flavorText: Nestled in a laquered case, these beautiful dice are intended to be used to count your prestige during a game of Tribute.
name: Jade Tribute Dice

title: Systres Salt Bath
flavorText: A packet of hand-gathered sea salts from the Systres Archipelago, intended for use in a hot bath.
name: Systres Salt Bath

title: Mariner Beard Oil
flavorText: Five out of six Gonfalon Bay sailors swear by it. Keeps your facial hair lustrous.
name: Mariner Beard Oil

title: Knightly Armor Polish
flavorText: A half-empty jar with the symbol of the Order of the Iron Knot on the cork.
name: Knightly Armor Polish

title: Captain's Hairbrush
flavorText: Made with horsehair and carved with a large squid running up the handle.
name: Captain's Hairbrush

title: Betty Netch Ambergris Pomade
flavorText: That famous brand with the Netch right on the label! A strong grease intended for hair styling.
name: Betty Netch Ambergris Pomade

title: Seaman's Scouring Brush
flavorText: A well-made flat horsehair brush used by mariners to quickly and roughly clean themselves at sea.
name: Seaman's Scouring Brush

title: Ascendant Order Codebook
flavorText: At first glance, a populist tract. Sigils at the back allow loyalists to decode its true message.
name: Ascendant Order Codebook

title: Blank Tribute Card
flavorText: Made with heavy stock, a member of the Roister's club has yet to mark this card as part of a deck.
name: Blank Tribute Card

title: Hadolid Claw Letter Opener
flavorText: A letter opener made from a small preserved Hadolid claw. Still smells faintly gamey.
name: Hadolid Claw Letter Opener

title: All Flags Calligraphy Set
flavorText: A beautiful set of parchments, inks, and quills from the offices on All Flags Isle.
name: All Flags Calligraphy Set

title: Gonfalon Colossus Paperweight
flavorText: A heavy, flat-bottomed wood carving of the Gonfalon Colossus statue with several holes for holding quills.
name: Gonfalon Colossus Paperweight

title: House Mornard Seal Stamp
flavorText: An official wax seal used to stamp missives from an august noble family of the Systres Archipelago.
name: House Mornard Seal Stamp

title: Gonfalon Bay Collector's Spoon
flavorText: A little image of the Gonfalon Colossus is etched into this pewter spoon.
name: Gonfalon Bay Collector's Spoon

title: Roister's Club Carving Knife
flavorText: An ornamental carving knife used at Roister's Club banquets during the New Life festival.
name: Roister's Club Carving Knife

title: Hadolid Meat Skewer
flavorText: A large pointy-tipped rod about the size of a child, intended for use in charring Hadolids over an open flame.
name: Hadolid Meat Skewer

title: Knotwood Cutlery Set
flavorText: Made by the Druids of High Isle, no carving tool was used to shape the wood for this knife, fork, and spoon set.
name: Knotwood Cutlery Set

title: "Sinistral" Fork
flavorText: A tourist gewgaw sold to gullible tamsfolk. Salespeople claim it's part of an ancient set left behind by Lefthanded Elves.
name: "Sinistral" Fork

title: Tourney Aspirant's Mess Kit
flavorText: Set in a leather case embossed with symbols of the three Sapphire Orders, this kit was given to every aspirant at the Tourney.
name: Tourney Aspirant's Mess Kit

title: Werewolf Cub Doll Set
flavorText: Little werewolf shaped people fashioned from cloth for young werechildren to chew and play with.
name: Werewolf Cub Doll Set

title: "Erotica for Werewolves"
flavorText: A ragged, hand-written tract detailing very specific acts for a very specific readership.
name: "Erotica for Werewolves"

title: Wereclan Territory Marker
flavorText: A werewolf skull, painted with symbols outside and with a candle set inside. Used to mark the edges of a pack's territory.
name: Wereclan Territory Marker

title: Carcass Spice Container
flavorText: A tin of strong spices etched with the symbol of Hircine. Used by werewolves to accentuate their meals.
name: Carcass Spice Container

title: Werebeast Cologne
flavorText: A pungent musk intended for the werewolf-about-town. Smells of blood, rotting deer carcass, and urine.
name: Werebeast Cologne

title: Sapphire Tourney Hourglass
flavorText: Used in some of the more time-sensitive trials at the knightly tourney held at Castle Navire.
name: Sapphire Tourney Hourglass

title: Broken Windup Galleon
flavorText: Before it was dropped, you could wind up this small mechanical boat and let it scoot along the ground.
name: Broken Windup Galleon

title: Copper Plate Desalinator
flavorText: A portable kit with copper plates and cloths, can be used by stranded mariners to draw fresh water from salt water.
name: Copper Plate Desalinator

title: Multi-purpose Sextant
flavorText: Somewhat impractical, this device attempts to combine a sextant, compass, knife, corkscrew, and jeweler's loop.
name: Multi-purpose Sextant

title: Clockwork Card Shuffler
flavorText: An elaborate mechanism used to shuffle Tribute decks during official tournaments.
name: Clockwork Card Shuffler

title: A Guide to Skooma
flavorText: A small pouch with a note attached that describes how to make the most of your skooma experience.
name: A Guide to Skooma

title: Vial of Numbing Salve
flavorText: A small vial of a numbing balm said to help ease the symptoms of skooma withdrawal. It's half empty.
name: Vial of Numbing Salve

title: Bejeweled Sugar Pipe Stem
flavorText: This intricately decorated stem must have once belonged to a pipe used to smoke skooma. It's still intact.
name: Bejeweled Sugar Pipe Stem

title: Carved Pipe Water Jar
flavorText: The bowl for a water pipe used for smoking skooma. Depictions of Jone and Jode are rather intricately carved around all sides.
name: Carved Pipe Water Jar

title: Tiny Model Ship
flavorText: A detailed miniature ship modeled after a real Dufort ship.
name: Tiny Model Ship

title: Druidic Stone Puzzle
flavorText: A puzzle comprised of stones of various sizes and shapes. It's immediately clear how the pieces fit together.
name: Druidic Stone Puzzle

title: Una the Green Elk Figurine
flavorText: A small carved figurine of one of the lesser revered spirits in druid culture.
name: Una the Green Elk Figurine

title: Knight of the Albatross Figurine
flavorText: A pocket-sized figure dressed like a Knight of the Albatross. It has a little sword.
name: Knight of the Albatross Figurine

title: Wood Training Staff
flavorText: This seems to be fashioned after a magic staff but small enough that a child could hold it. It has no magical properties.
name: Wood Training Staff

title: Gold Gonfalon Colossus Figurine
flavorText: A miniature, gold-painted version of the famous Gonfalon Colossus.
name: Gold Gonfalon Colossus Figurine

title: Flat Bottom Ship Kettle
flavorText: This kettle is flat all the way around the bottom in order to keep it from tipping when on rough seas.
name: Flat Bottom Ship Kettle

title: Small Delicacy Fork
flavorText: An almost laughably small fork, used only for navigating Gonfalon Bay's exquisite seafood.
name: Small Delicacy Fork

title: Galley Soup Bowl
flavorText: A fancy soup bowl with a weighted bottom, used for fine dining aboard larger ships.
name: Galley Soup Bowl

title: Golden Crustacean Cracker
flavorText: An extravagant tool used to crack the shells of the crustaceans in order to eat them. A small crab is engraved on the handle.
name: Golden Crustacean Cracker

title: Passion Flower Vase
flavorText: The passion flowers painted on the face of this vase are so detailed, one might imagine a butterfly rustling through the petals.
name: Passion Flower Vase

title: Stonelore Circle Gathering Bowl
flavorText: This woven bowl is made from thick, waxy branches and is used by the Stonelore Circle Druids to collect herbs for medicine.
name: Stonelore Circle Gathering Bowl

title: Badge of the Systres Guard
flavorText: A tarnished brass badge from a member of the Systres Guard. It must have been discarded by someone.
name: Badge of the Systres Guard

title: Systres Guard Manacles
flavorText: A pair of restraints stamped with the symbol of the Systres Guard. They are broken.
name: Systres Guard Manacles

title: Guide for Systres Guards' Exam
flavorText: This small booklet seems to be full of things for prospective Systres Guards to study before enlisting.
name: Guide for Systres Guards' Exam

title: Systres Guard Whistle
flavorText: A standard issue whistle given to each member of the Systres Guard for them to keep on their person.
name: Systres Guard Whistle

title: Druidic Compass
flavorText: While clearly broken, this compass used to hold a small pool of water and still has the lodestone attached to the center.
name: Druidic Compass

title: Stonelore Circle Raincatcher
flavorText: This wide clay bowl has petals carved into the surface to create rivulets that pool into the center once rain is collected.
name: Stonelore Circle Raincatcher

title: Tree Bark Trowl
flavorText: A hand trowl used for farming, fashioned from the bark of a tree and various branches.
name: Tree Bark Trowl

title: Stonelore Circle Spirit Conduit
flavorText: A strange container fashioned out of tree bark, supposedly used to allow druids to commune with nature spirits.
name: Stonelore Circle Spirit Conduit

title: Enchanted Hand Pail
flavorText: A supposedly enchanted pail that promises to draw milk from cows without needing physical intervention.
name: Enchanted Hand Pail

title: Enchanted Chicken Xylophone
flavorText: A wooden xylophone enchanted to play a pleasing melody when chickens peck at the bars.
name: Enchanted Chicken Xylophone

title: Druidic Grass Rain Shawl
flavorText: A shawl made from tightly woven fibers. It's strangely resistant to water, much like a duck's wing.
name: Druidic Grass Rain Shawl

title: Broken Balancing Glasses
flavorText: These glasses once held a liquid inside the rim, meant to simulate the horizon to minimize sea sickness.
name: Broken Balancing Glasses

title: Petrified Branch Pins
flavorText: Made from petrified pieces of bark, sturdy enough not to fall out of your hair but probably not enough to pick a lock.
name: Petrified Branch Pins

title: Druidic Elder Scarf
flavorText: A scarf worn by the elders of the Stonelore Circle Druids to symbolize their wisdom and age.
name: Druidic Elder Scarf

title: Gonfalon Bay Parasol
flavorText: A lovely parasol embroidered with care. Used by the nobles of Gonfalon Bay to keep the sun out of their eyes.
name: Gonfalon Bay Parasol

title: Noble's Silken Shoulder Wrap
flavorText: Only for those with expensive tastes, this shoulder wrap is used by nobles in Gonfalon Bay to display their wealth.
name: Noble's Silken Shoulder Wrap

title: Blood Smelling Salts
flavorText: For vampires who abstain from feeding for too long, this small vial is said to help curb cravings.
name: Blood Smelling Salts

title: Iron Fang Shaper
flavorText: A specialized sharpener made for the fangs of vampires.
name: Iron Fang Shaper

title: Golden Blood Siphon
flavorText: Well-polished font used to collect a small amount of blood from willing participants.
name: Golden Blood Siphon

title: Embossed Scarlet Dice
flavorText: These dice have an unsettling crimson sheen to them. When they roll, a small amount of liquid inside seems to move.
name: Embossed Scarlet Dice

title: Death Hound Whistle
flavorText: This whistle was made for a specific Death Hound, likely used by the vampire it answered to once upon a time.
name: Death Hound Whistle

title: Baroness Chatillon's Sword Hilt
flavorText: Supposedly part of Baroness Belene Chatillon's favored weapon before she lost her arm to Sload rot.
name: Baroness Chatillon's Sword Hilt

title: Seasalt Spray
flavorText: Nobility use the saltwater in this bottle when they style their hair in the elaborate up-dos currently in fashion on High Isle.
name: Seasalt Spray

title: Sailor's Kohl
flavorText: A dark liquid layered artfully under the eyes to keep sailors from going blind while at sea.
name: Sailor's Kohl

title: Kelp Skin Cream
flavorText: Merchants spread this green tinted gel over their skin to soften it before meeting important buyers.
name: Kelp Skin Cream

title: Nereid Blue Blush
flavorText: Skilled artists and performers use this powder to create the illusion of fish scales on their cheeks.
name: Nereid Blue Blush

title: Matys' Marvelous Tidepool Tincture
flavorText: The label suspended from the vial's cork promises that the contents will turn blue hair green.
name: Matys' Marvelous Tidepool Tincture

title: Scarlet Lip Balm
flavorText: This smooth paste reportedly maintains its vibrant red color throughout an entire feast.
name: Scarlet Lip Balm

title: Tales of Forest and Song
flavorText: A book filled with stories attributed to Y'ffre.
name: Tales of Forest and Song

title: The Closed Eye of Arkay
flavorText: A stone eye--shut in eternal rest. This small talisman is often given to mourning families.
name: The Closed Eye of Arkay

title: Julianos's Mystery Box
flavorText: A lesson in creative and rigorous thinking, the lid of this box has never been opened.
name: Julianos's Mystery Box

title: Divination Claws
flavorText: Cast in meditation or to ask Akatosh for guidance directly, these claws are inscribed with sacred words and symbols.
name: Divination Claws

title: Blessed Abacus
flavorText: It is said that when a priest of Julianos uses this abacus, the sums always align.
name: Blessed Abacus

title: Golden Sun Talisman of Magnus
flavorText: A shining piece of metal that reflects even the dimmest rays of light to brighten a room.
name: Golden Sun Talisman of Magnus

title: Octopus Mug
flavorText: A clever potter transformed this sculpted octopus' tentacle into the mug's handle.
name: Octopus Mug

title: All Flags Stein
flavorText: This stein is covered in the ship's colors that sailed in the All Flags Navy.
name: All Flags Stein

title: Ancient Anchor Bottle Stopper
flavorText: The cork is etched with the symbol of Gonfalon Bay's beloved inn.
name: Ancient Anchor Bottle Stopper

title: Seaglass Wine Decanter
flavorText: This decanter is studded with rounded pieces of blue, green, and white glass that wash ashore.
name: Seaglass Wine Decanter

title: Vintage Birchwine Canteen
flavorText: This canteen is empty, but it smells faintly like spices and some sweet alcohol.
name: Vintage Birchwine Canteen

title: Faun Feast Decanter
flavorText: Small figurines of fauns dance around the bottom of this decanter, the top is stopped tightly and cannot be opened.
name: Faun Feast Decanter

title: Cleaning Board
flavorText: A sun-bleached wooden plank used as a flat surface for gutting fish while at sea.
name: Cleaning Board

title: Seashell Weighted Net
flavorText: Popular because it's easy to maintain, this net is laden with seashell weights.
name: Seashell Weighted Net

title: Nereid Tacklebox
flavorText: This tacklebox is adorned in shells, kelp fronds, coral, and other materials scavenged from tidepools.
name: Nereid Tacklebox

title: Flowers of Love Fishing Rod
flavorText: Practicing druids carve petals and flowers into the twisted wood of their fishing rods to pay homage to Y'ffre.
name: Flowers of Love Fishing Rod

title: Coral Mudcrap Trap
flavorText: The bars of this polyp studded cage were fashioned with the express purpose of becoming encrusted with coral.
name: Coral Mudcrap Trap

title: Glass Display Fishbowl
flavorText: A startlingly clear bowl used by nobility to display the most exquisite catch of the day.
name: Glass Display Fishbowl

title: Conch Shell Horn
flavorText: In the hands of a drunken mariner, this beautiful shell can produce some truly dreadful sounds.
name: Conch Shell Horn

title: Compact Ship's Drum
flavorText: When the wind dies down at sea, this drum is used to help rowers keep the beat.
name: Compact Ship's Drum

title: Druid's Whispering Willow Flute
flavorText: A reeded flute instrument. Some say the druids learned how to make it from High Isle's fauns.
name: Druid's Whispering Willow Flute

title: Seamless Stone Ocarina
flavorText: Hollowed by magic, this rock has been lovingly sanded smooth and produces a sound not unlike blowing over an empty bottle.
name: Seamless Stone Ocarina

title: Popular Work Shanty Sheet Music
flavorText: Lyrics and basic notation to the song 'Sailing's Rough Down Amenos Way.'
name: Popular Work Shanty Sheet Music

title: Stonelore Dancing Wrist Chimes
flavorText: A bracelet of bells wrapped around dancer's wrists and shaken rhythmically while the dancers twirl around a bonfire.
name: Stonelore Dancing Wrist Chimes

title: Lead Weights
flavorText: Small metal weights used to measure out raw materials before they are forged.
name: Lead Weights

title: Harpoon Head
flavorText: This barbed steel harpoon-tip is weathered from years at sea.
name: Harpoon Head

title: Wooden Mark Stamps
flavorText: The wood is charred, but somehow the mark of the Faunfire Forge is clean and distinct.
name: Wooden Mark Stamps

title: Animal Illustrations
flavorText: Smiths take inspiration from these drawings to replicate the animal's shapes in metal.
name: Animal Illustrations

title: Sea's Waste Polish
flavorText: Consisting of sand and finely crushed shells, this polish removes rust and other impurities caused by exposure to sea spray.
name: Sea's Waste Polish

title: Mondrar's Mold Mooring Paste
flavorText: A thick sludge like paste used to temporarily seal any cracks in a mold. Guaranteed to last until another mold can be made.
name: Mondrar's Mold Mooring Paste

title: Letter in a Bottle
flavorText: The bottle is stopped tight with a swollen cork. Whatever letter is inside, it's well protected against the waves.
name: Letter in a Bottle

title: Old Ship's Manifests
flavorText: A roll of manifests. Many of the ships have been marked as lost at sea or decommissioned.
name: Old Ship's Manifests

title: Midyear Star Chart
flavorText: A guide to the night's sky during Midyear that Navigators use aboard ships to plan their routes at night.
name: Midyear Star Chart

title: Harbormaster's Badge
flavorText: A rounded metal disc with a pin on the back to secure it to a jacket. There's a picture of the docks engraved into the metal.
name: Harbormaster's Badge

title: Lineage of House Dufort
flavorText: The Dufort's extensive family tree. It spans past the family's arrival on High Isle.
name: Lineage of House Dufort

title: Illiterate Chef's Guide to Seafood
flavorText: An illustrated primer with crossed out pictures of poisonous sea creatures on each page.
name: Illiterate Chef's Guide to Seafood

title: Mornard Poppet
flavorText: This stuffed doll resembles a squire of House Mornard with bizarre dimensions and exaggerated features.
name: Mornard Poppet

title: Stuffed Whale
flavorText: A plush purple whale stuffed with sheep's wool.
name: Stuffed Whale

title: Mounted Knight Marionette
flavorText: This delightful marionette features a gangly knight astride his clumsy wooden horse. Very popular in children's theater.
name: Mounted Knight Marionette

title: Plush Faun
flavorText: Even in plush form, this faun is somewhat unsettling to look at.
name: Plush Faun

title: Elea Dress-Up Doll
flavorText: This exquisite porcelain doll resembles Duchess Elea Dufort down to the shade of her makeup.
name: Elea Dress-Up Doll

title: Vulk'esh Bean-Bag
flavorText: Filled with dried beans, this toy fissure fiend appears saggy and listless.
name: Vulk'esh Bean-Bag

title: Deer Skin Rug
flavorText: This simple buckskin pelt is a popular floor covering in commoners' houses across the Systres.
name: Deer Skin Rug

title: Sail-Canvas Tablecloth
flavorText: This tablecloth was once a ship's jib sail--just the thing for semi-formal events in seaside taverns.
name: Sail-Canvas Tablecloth

title: Gonfalon Lobster Bib
flavorText: A linen bib featuring an embroidered lobster saying something pithy. Delightful!
name: Gonfalon Lobster Bib

title: Fine Linen Hammock
flavorText: A luxury item for wealthier seamen--likely to be ripped or stolen by the end of a long voyage.
name: Fine Linen Hammock

title: Albatross Kerchief
flavorText: This fine linen kerchief likely came from the sleeve of a fabulous Knight of the Albatross.
name: Albatross Kerchief

title: Swan Down Pillow
flavorText: Imported from Summerset, pillows like this are quite popular among High Isle's aristrocracy.
name: Swan Down Pillow

title: Shimmering Ammonite
flavorText: This ammonite emits a faint glow on account of its untapped arcane energies.
name: Shimmering Ammonite

title: Druidic Knucklebones
flavorText: Deer knuckles, popular among druidic fortunetellers.
name: Druidic Knucklebones

title: Ammonite Ensorceling Guide
flavorText: This complex diagram depicts how one might draw arcane energy from an Eltheric ammonite.
name: Ammonite Ensorceling Guide

title: Frog Metal Soles
flavorText: These laced plates of bouyant metal allow the wearer to walk on water … as long as the wearer weighs less than a toddler.
name: Frog Metal Soles

title: Atmoran Chillstone
flavorText: This rune-etched stone emits bitter cold--perfect for chilling produce for long voyages.
name: Atmoran Chillstone

title: Ever-Inked Plume
flavorText: A writing implement that never goes dry! Very popular among travelling scholars.
name: Ever-Inked Plume

title: Oakenvald Pegleg
flavorText: This heavy false leg could easily double as a club in the right hands.
name: Oakenvald Pegleg

title: Druidic Healing Paste
flavorText: Systrean druids muddle rare sea grasses to create a odiferous paste that is perfect for burns.
name: Druidic Healing Paste

title: Kelpweave Tourniquet
flavorText: The weave on this tourniquet cinches tight without much effort.
name: Kelpweave Tourniquet

title: Steadfast Woundwash
flavorText: The composition of this sweet-smelling salve isn't immediately clear, but healers at Steadfast Manor swear by it.
name: Steadfast Woundwash

title: Pyandonean Suture-Kit
flavorText: The curved needle of this suture kit resembles a serpent's fang.
name: Pyandonean Suture-Kit

title: Firesong Soaking Salts
flavorText: Harvested from one of the Systres' many hot springs, these therapeutic salts put both mind and body at ease.
name: Firesong Soaking Salts

title: Faun Hoof
flavorText: This dried hoof almost certainly came from the leg of a faun. Good luck or just gross? Who can say?
name: Faun Hoof

title: Hadolid Claw
flavorText: A length of rope loops through the claw, making it a macabre keychain.
name: Hadolid Claw

title: Ornaug Molars
flavorText: Hunters often fashion trinkets and buttons from Ornaug teeth. These would make an exceptional set of dice.
name: Ornaug Molars

title: Dried Sea Elf Fingers
flavorText: Cut from the hand of a Sea Elf corsair, these digits are conversation pieces to be sure.
name: Dried Sea Elf Fingers

title: Igneous Coprolite
flavorText: Vulk'esh excriment often hardens into slag-like chunks. Heavy? No doubt. Useful? Maybe?
name: Igneous Coprolite

title: Bottled Druid Eye
flavorText: The label on this bottle indicates it contains a druid's eye. It's probably too late to return it.
name: Bottled Druid Eye

title: Scrimshaw Kynareth
flavorText: A small bird wearing a crown--a common Systrean depiction of the godess of the winds.
name: Scrimshaw Kynareth

title: Y'ffre Worrystone
flavorText: Leafy motifs cover this smooth river stone, perfect for rubbing during times of stress.
name: Y'ffre Worrystone

title: Wooden Draoife
flavorText: This small collection of druid-shaped figures probably depicts the druid's ruling body, the Draoife.
name: Wooden Draoife

title: Ebony Mermaid Figurine
flavorText: This tiny stone mermaid curls her tail seductively. A common fertility idol for High Isle commoners.
name: Ebony Mermaid Figurine

title: Miniature All Flags Monument
flavorText: This tiny obelisk is hewn from creamy white marble.
name: Miniature All Flags Monument

title: Syrabane Statuette
flavorText: This tiny depiction of the Elven sorcerer deity holds a staff and brandishes his magic ring.
name: Syrabane Statuette

title: Monkey's Fist Knot
flavorText: A difficult but useful knot for sailors, climbers, and other working folk.
name: Monkey's Fist Knot

title: Acorn Collection
flavorText: A visually pleasing array of twelve acorns--perfect in shape and varying in size.
name: Acorn Collection

title: Homemade Tribute Patron
flavorText: Someone carved a Tribute Patron token to resemble someone. Given the crudeness of the design, it's hard to guess who.
name: Homemade Tribute Patron

title: Larimar False Eye
flavorText: A smoothly polished blue stone, intended for ocular socketing.
name: Larimar False Eye

title: Amenos Geode
flavorText: Holding this colorful geode up to the sun casts a sparkling array of light onto any surface.
name: Amenos Geode

title: Taxidermied Octopus
flavorText: Someone went to great pains to make this dead cephalopod appear life-like. One can only guess why.
name: Taxidermied Octopus

title: Ra Gada Helm Ornament
flavorText: A beautiful orichalc bird with wide wings that once crowned a Yokudan Hel Shira's helmet. It is clearly Tava resplendent.
name: Ra Gada Helm Ornament

title: Pennanular Brooch of Duchess Guimard
flavorText: This diamond-studded brooch bears the seal of House Guimard. It may have belonged to Duchess Martinne Guimard herself.
name: Pennanular Brooch of Duchess Guimard

title: Statue of Mara's Rose
flavorText: A golden flower dedicated to the Divine Mother. It shines even in low light and is made of excellent materials.
name: Statue of Mara's Rose

setBonuses.description: (2 items) When you use Roll Dodge, create a Hadolid Husk after you roll. While within 5 meters of the Hadolid Husk, it will absorb all direct damage attacks against you. After |cffffff1|r second, the Hadolid Husk explodes, dealing 6301 Poison damage to all enemies within 5 meters. This effect can occur once every |cffffff20|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

traitDescription: Increase experience gained from kills by 7%.

enchantDescription: Adds 1085 Maximum Magicka.
flavorText: Eldertide skirmishers tap deep into the wellspring of power that runs beneath the Systres islands. The power of the True Way fuels their leaps and bounds, allowing feats that defy even the doughtiest knight.
name: Stormweaver's Cavort

setBonuses.description: (1 item) Sprint, Roll Dodge, Bash, Break Free, Sneak, and Block now consume Magicka instead of Stamina. You reduce your Magicka Recovery to |cffffff0|r while Blocking, Sneaking, or Sprinting. You no longer reduce your Stamina Recovery to |cffffff0|r while Blocking, Sneaking or Sprinting.

traitDescription: Increase armor enchantment effect by 25%.

title: Syrabane's Ward
enchantDescription:
Adds 175 Maximum Magicka.
Adds 193 Maximum Health.
Adds 175 Maximum Stamina.
flavorText: Later in life, Archmage Syrabane sought to perfect the obscure art of Mysticism. Endless lattices of protection layered within this clasp cause it to thrum with arcane power. |cff0000This item cannot be dyed.|r
name: Syrabane's Ward

setBonuses.description: (1 item) While actively Bracing, you create a 12 meter zone of protection but you can no longer move. Group members within the zone increase the amount of damage they can block by 30% and their Health Recovery by 950. The Health Recovery cannot affect yourself.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Block by 4%.

title: Legion's Arrival Clue
flavorText: A riddle that allows you to discover an upgraded Tribute card. This clue is needed to acquire the upgrade.
name: Legion's Arrival Clue

title: Forgotten Adventurer's Restoration Staff
enchantDescription: Increase your Weapon Damage and Spell Damage by |cffffff0|r for |cffffff5|r seconds.
flavorText: A mage's staff found in your strong box. Soothing energy leaks from the cracks and whorls of this aged staff. It should mend most wounds well enough.
name: Forgotten Adventurer's Restoration Staff
traitDescription: Increases experience gained from kills by |cffffff5|r%.

title: Forgotten Adventurer's Sword
enchantDescription: Increase your Weapon Damage and Spell Damage by |cffffff0|r for |cffffff5|r seconds.
flavorText: A sword found in your strong box. Dulled by age and disuse but with the right technique, it can still deal out ample punishment.
name: Forgotten Adventurer's Sword
traitDescription: Increases experience gained from kills by |cffffff2.5|r%.

title: Forgotten Adventurer's Dagger
enchantDescription: Increase your Weapon Damage and Spell Damage by |cffffff0|r for |cffffff5|r seconds.
flavorText: A dagger found in your strong box. Centuries of neglect have robbed this blade of its luster, but in the right hands it can still draw blood.
name: Forgotten Adventurer's Dagger
traitDescription: Increases experience gained from kills by |cffffff2.5|r%.

title: Forgotten Adventurer's Shield
flavorText: A shield found in your strong box. The ravages of time may have tarnished this aegis, but it remains strong enough to deflect a golem's blows.
name: Forgotten Adventurer's Shield
traitDescription: Increase experience gained from kills by 2.5%.

title: Forgotten Adventurer's Strong Box
flavorText: This box supposedly belongs to you, though your memory of it is hazy. Nonetheless, its contents will help you get back on your feet.
name: Forgotten Adventurer's Strong Box

title: Forgotten Adventurer's Gloves
flavorText: The fingers are clearly fraying. These will offer only trivial protection.
name: Forgotten Adventurer's Gloves

title: Forgotten Adventurer's Belt
flavorText: Not much more than a rough strip of leather to hold your tattered outfit together.
name: Forgotten Adventurer's Belt

title: Forgotten Adventurer's Boots
flavorText: Old and worn but comfortable enough for the journey ahead.
name: Forgotten Adventurer's Boots

title: Forgotten Adventurer's Battle Axe
enchantDescription: Increase your Weapon Damage and Spell Damage by |cffffff0|r for |cffffff5|r seconds.
flavorText: While it may not be as sharp as it once was, this Elven cleaver can still hew flesh, wood, and stone with brutal efficiency.
name: Forgotten Adventurer's Battle Axe
traitDescription: Increases experience gained from kills by |cffffff5|r%.

flavorText: Seasonal transition is a part of Y'ffre's plan. After planting this tree in your home, you can show your reverence for the God of Song and Forest by adjusting its state to spring, summer, fall, or winter.
name: Tree, Seasons of Y'ffre

title: Crafter's Style Materials Crate: Special Edition
flavorText: This crate is laden with the materials to make equipment in every style from the Crown Store or events.
name: Crafter's Style Materials Crate: Special Edition

title: Crafter's Style Materials Crate II
flavorText: This crate is laden with the materials to make equipment in every style from Imperial City through Murkmire.
name: Crafter's Style Materials Crate II

title: Crafter's Style Materials Crate IV
flavorText: This crate is laden with the materials to make equipment in every style from Ascending Tide and beyond.
name: Crafter's Style Materials Crate IV

title: Chenille Stem Bundle
flavorText: These flexible wire strands are used practically to clean pipes, and less practically to twist into fuzzy little shapes.
name: Chenille Stem Bundle

title: Covenant Sigil Silkscreen Set
flavorText: A fine silk mesh stretched across a wooden frame. The accompanying stencil depicts the Covenant lion sigil.
name: Covenant Sigil Silkscreen Set

title: Ornate Button Collection
flavorText: A lifetime's hoard of colorful buttons held in a wooden cask. No two in the collection are alike.
name: Ornate Button Collection

title: Seafarer's Stained Glass Portrait
flavorText: A hand-sized portrait made of stained glass in the likeness of Kynareth. Hangable by a small chain.
name: Seafarer's Stained Glass Portrait

title: High Isle Merino Wool
flavorText: A bobbin of soft, undyed, lovingly hand-spun wool originating from a tiny flock on the south side of High Isle.
name: High Isle Merino Wool

title: Vastyr Storm Glass
flavorText: The alchemical mixture inside this glass cylinder seems attuned to the movements of the sea and sky.
name: Vastyr Storm Glass

title: Faun Antler Dowsing Rod
flavorText: This twitchy appendage guides the user to bodies of fresh water, usually by way of sinkhole or over a cliff.
name: Faun Antler Dowsing Rod

title: Coral Prayer Charms
flavorText: A Maormer-made pouch of coin-sized coral discs carved with the likeness of sea serpents. When cast into water, they float.
name: Coral Prayer Charms

title: Forest Wraith Offering
flavorText: An assortment of bones, quills, and feathers bound by a strip of hide. Unknown if it attracts or repels forest wraiths.
name: Forest Wraith Offering

title: Firesong Druidic Lodestone
flavorText: This rough-hewn compass always points in the direction of Y'ffelon.
name: Firesong Druidic Lodestone

title: Hircine's Gambrel
flavorText: Lightweight and portable, this ornately-carved tool is used to hoist one's prey for skinning after a prosperous hunt.
name: Hircine's Gambrel

title: Firesong Magma Censer
flavorText: The exterior of this egg-shaped censer is reminiscent of magma-like vulk'esh markings. It is unnaturally warm to the touch.
name: Firesong Magma Censer

title: Gull Feather Shuttlecock
flavorText: Traditionally used as a lure in falconry, some Bretons have made a sport of making this item "fly" using wooden paddles.
name: Gull Feather Shuttlecock

title: Hoops & Holes Wicket Set
flavorText: A standard set of oblong wooden hoops for staking in the ground, used in the popular noble's game, "Hoops & Holes."
name: Hoops & Holes Wicket Set

title: Bosun's Call
flavorText: A card deck of prompts for a musical call-and-response game popular in seaside taverns.
name: Bosun's Call

title: Maormer Mancala Set
flavorText: This well-used board is inlaid with mother of pearl and played with colorful seaglass stones.
name: Maormer Mancala Set

title: Proof!
flavorText: A murder mystery role-playing card game inspired by the massively popular Investigator Vale book series.
name: Proof!

title: Dire Straits
flavorText: Played on a pegboard with many moving pieces, the objective of this game has to do with capturing ports and sinking ships.
name: Dire Straits

title: Nitpicker's Ear Cleaning Set
flavorText: A pliable set of wooden utensils used for scraping detritus from any imaginable aural crevice.
name: Nitpicker's Ear Cleaning Set

title: Mount Firesong Breath Chews
flavorText: These gingery chews are infused with charcoal, promising a brighter smile, fresh breath, and clear sinuses.
name: Mount Firesong Breath Chews

title: Volcanic Exfoliation Stone
flavorText: A porous, pocket-sized rock used to slough off dead skin and soften your roughest edges.
name: Volcanic Exfoliation Stone

title: Eau de Amenos
flavorText: Aromatic cologne that evokes a dark bouquet of rain, smoke, and innate danger.
name: Eau de Amenos

title: Mariner's Hair and Beard Spray
flavorText: The fine glass bottle boasts of a stylish, textured, "just off the ship" look. The liquid inside, however, is just seawater.
name: Mariner's Hair and Beard Spray

title: Lanolin Shepherd's Balm
flavorText: This tin of greasy, musky-smelling balm promises protection from everything—from sun and wind, to wolves and quicksand.
name: Lanolin Shepherd's Balm

title: Igneous Quill Holder
flavorText: The natural holes in this porous volcanic rock have been shaped to hold an assortment of quills.
name: Igneous Quill Holder

title: Ornaug-Spine Etching Needles
flavorText: A collection of sharp spikes harvested from the dorsal spine of an ornaug. Perfect for wax etching in fine detail.
name: Ornaug-Spine Etching Needles

title: Seal Seal
flavorText: A pressable wax seal carved in the shape of a flippered marine animal—like a smooth, tuskless horker.
name: Seal Seal

title: Night Sight Reading Glass
flavorText: A palm-sized dome of glass that magnifies the words on a page beneath it. Enchanted to glow at the touch of fingertips.
name: Night Sight Reading Glass

title: Enchanted Dictation Quill
flavorText: A quill enchanted for hands-free use. You'll still need a scribe to correct its many errors.
name: Enchanted Dictation Quill

title: Fore-edge Painting Traveler's Journal
flavorText: When its pages are fanned, this leather-bound journal reveals a painting of the Colossus of Gonfalon Bay.
name: Fore-edge Painting Traveler's Journal

title: Steel Marlinspike
flavorText: This cone-shaped metal rod is used by Tamrielic mariners for all manner of ropework.
name: Steel Marlinspike

title: Whalebone Netting Needles
flavorText: Different sized needles bundled in a fish leather wrap. Maormer use these to repair fishing nets.
name: Whalebone Netting Needles

title: Meat Mallet
flavorText: Used to tenderize and flatten cuts of meat. Also useful in pacifying belligerent taverngoers.
name: Meat Mallet

title: Handheld Flour Sifter
flavorText: A vital instrument for achieving the light, airy texture typical of Breton pastries.
name: Handheld Flour Sifter

title: High Iron Crochet Hooks
flavorText: This set of enchanted metal hooks grow hot to signal when the user misses a stitch.
name: High Iron Crochet Hooks

title: Systres Archipelago Novel-Tea Infuser
flavorText: This anchor-shaped novelty sinks straight to the bottom of your mug for ideal tea diffusion.
name: Systres Archipelago Novel-Tea Infuser

title: Lycanthrope Treatment Pamphlet
flavorText: A mass-produced missive written by Prelate Sabinus, extoling the virtues of Arkay and offering a cure for lycanthropy.
name: Lycanthrope Treatment Pamphlet

title: Bristleneck Ear
flavorText: Older werewolves test their bite on these dry, chewy treats.
name: Bristleneck Ear

title: Lunar Calendar
flavorText: By setting the phase of the moon on the first day of the year, it displays the moons' phases for the rest of the given year.
name: Lunar Calendar

title: Bloodmoon Oil
flavorText: A red-tinged oil with unknown alchemical properties, supposedly infused with light from Secunda during a Great Hunt.
name: Bloodmoon Oil

title: Paw Pad Poultice
flavorText: An mint-smelling paste used to soothe injuries to the pad of a werewolf's paws.
name: Paw Pad Poultice

title: Bone-Handled Boline
flavorText: A small, crescent moon-shaped knife used by werewolves to harvest tufts of fur for ritual purposes.
name: Bone-Handled Boline

title: Handy Stitching Awl
flavorText: Used to puncture or enlarge holes. Not picky about the material.
name: Handy Stitching Awl

title: Treated Maple Book Cradle
flavorText: A simple device that props books upright for ease of reading.
name: Treated Maple Book Cradle

title: Bristled Hoof Pick
flavorText: Hooked pick with a brush attachment on a wooden handle for cleaning the hooves of any equine.
name: Bristled Hoof Pick

title: Bronze Shoe Horn
flavorText: Cheaper than a cobbler, this tool guides highborn heels into stubbornly narrow shoes.
name: Bronze Shoe Horn

title: Rotary Whisk
flavorText: A clever little hand crank device that quickly whisks ingredients, wet or dry. Apron advised.
name: Rotary Whisk

title: Cheese Wire
flavorText: A sharp length of wire affixed between two wooden handles. Used for slicing through large wheels of cheese. And nothing else.
name: Cheese Wire

title: Hollowed Out Brass Spyglass
flavorText: Made to look like a common spyglass, its lense can be popped out to reveal a hiding place for a bottle of skooma.
name: Hollowed Out Brass Spyglass

title: Shivers Chewing Chalk
flavorText: A hard, chalky substance purported to treat the effects of skooma sickness. Chew twice daily for best effects.
name: Shivers Chewing Chalk

title: Spiral Sugar Pipe
flavorText: Hand-carved using shells from the beaches of High Isle.
name: Spiral Sugar Pipe

title: Pewter Sugar Box
flavorText: A sweet smelling box made to hold moon sugar. Scratch marks around the lock have damaged an engraving of the owner's initials.
name: Pewter Sugar Box

title: Khajiiti Moon Sugar Dish
flavorText: A small, ceremonial dish with a depiction of Azurah. Moon sugar remnants can be found in the engraving's thin lines.
name: Khajiiti Moon Sugar Dish

title: Collapsable Sugar Pipe
flavorText: While most sugar pipes can be cumbersome to carry, this collapsible pipe is perfect for spontaneous consumption.
name: Collapsable Sugar Pipe

title: Hatchling's Chewing Bone
flavorText: An Argonian child's chew toy made from the femur of a hackwing. Chew marks nearly obscure an inscription that reads, "Bemuk."
name: Hatchling's Chewing Bone

title: Model Lighthouse
flavorText: The top of this toy lighthouse has slots for both a small mirror and candle, and the symbol for Kynareth carved into the bottom.
name: Model Lighthouse

title: Wooden Colossus
flavorText: A wooden doll made to look like the Gonfalon Colossus. Its cape is made from coarse, dyed linen.
name: Wooden Colossus

title: Child's Shell Whistle
flavorText: When blown, this shell makes a sound not unlike the calls of sea birds. Be warned, not everyone "appreciates" this effect.
name: Child's Shell Whistle

title: Stuffed Sload
flavorText: A cheerful looking Sload with glittery, sea glass eyes. Pressing its belly makes a deep croaking sound.
name: Stuffed Sload

title: Beginner's Compass
flavorText: A shiny compass with a bold, colorful dial. Its needle is a spinning sea bird whose beak always points north.
name: Beginner's Compass

title: Driftwood Serving Bowl
flavorText: Made of smooth, sanded driftwood; the crafter's initials are carved into its bottom, but they are too worn to read.
name: Driftwood Serving Bowl

title: Jug of Spiced Cooking Oil
flavorText: A corked ceramic jug containing a chef's personal spice blended cooking oil. Smells faintly of saltrice and columbine.
name: Jug of Spiced Cooking Oil

title: Jar of Fish Brine
flavorText: A jar filled with spices and a salty brine. Used to season fish and keep its meat from drying out.
name: Jar of Fish Brine

title: Gravy Galleon
flavorText: Made to look like a Gonfalon galleon, this serving boat can hold enough gravy for an entire evening party.
name: Gravy Galleon

title: Shimmerene Oil Vase
flavorText: A large, beautifully painted vase used to store oil for ceremonies. A craftmans stamp reveals its origins to be Shimmerene.
name: Shimmerene Oil Vase

title: Enchanted Grocers Twine
flavorText: Purported to keep packaged vegetables fresh longer, this spool of twine smells of honey and sparkles softly in the light.
name: Enchanted Grocers Twine

title: Pewter Armor Brush
flavorText: Used by a Vastyr city guard to protect their armor from the salty sea air. Its tough bristles are well worn from frequent use.
name: Pewter Armor Brush

title: Leather Deck Pouch
flavorText: An empty deck pouch used for holding cards. Its owner's name is written under the flap. Dryston "The Skeever" Nytte.
name: Leather Deck Pouch

title: Fresh Catch Inspection Tool
flavorText: A curved silver tool used to inspect the insides of fish for contraband without damaging the catch.
name: Fresh Catch Inspection Tool

title: Commemorative Service Flask
flavorText: A shining flask inscribed with the sigil of Vastyr. Given to city guards on their first anniversary of service.
name: Commemorative Service Flask

title: Carved Kynareth Charm
flavorText: Carved from coral, sailors believed these charms protect the wearer from the unpredictability of the sea.
name: Carved Kynareth Charm

title: Hoarker Oil Polish
flavorText: An expensive fatty, oily substance used to shine armor to a near mirror-like polish.
name: Hoarker Oil Polish

title: Jangling Livestock Collar
flavorText: A leather collar with small bells, used to track young, wandering farm animals like curious goats and sheep.
name: Jangling Livestock Collar

title: Simple Cattle Splint
flavorText: A simple splint used to treat minor cattle injuries. It has slots where linen straps can be looped through for a tighter hold.
name: Simple Cattle Splint

title: Soot Stained Bellows
flavorText: A sturdy set of bellows covered in a fine layer of soot. The Vastyr crest is carved into its wooden panels.
name: Soot Stained Bellows

title: Enchanted Soil Probe
flavorText: This simple, enchanted tool is used by farmers to measure salinity prior to planting crops. Its tip glows blue in bad soil.
name: Enchanted Soil Probe

title: Commemorative Set of Chisels
flavorText: A set of chisels with mahogany handles. Awarded to skilled blacksmiths by the Vastyr Merchants Guild.
name: Commemorative Set of Chisels

title: Guar Training Toy
flavorText: A toy used to saddle train adolescent guar. Its low pitched honk mimics a guar mother's cooing.
name: Guar Training Toy

title: Gonfalon Decorative Waistband
flavorText: A satin cloth worn over formal wear during special occasions. An adjustable cinch makes it easy to wear over a guard's armor.
name: Gonfalon Decorative Waistband

title: Gaudy Sailor's Handkerchief
flavorText: Made from exquisite silks and embroidered with the Gonfalon compass. A terrible shore leave purchase, no doubt.
name: Gaudy Sailor's Handkerchief

title: Engraved Tabard Clasp
flavorText: Worn down by sea and sweat, you can still make out the engraving of the Gonfalon Colossus on this small, decorative clasp.
name: Engraved Tabard Clasp

title: Coral Rossette Hat Pin
flavorText: A finely carved coral brooch made to look like a delicate flower. Its petals seem to glow softly in the sunlight.
name: Coral Rossette Hat Pin

title: Alfiq Moonstone Bangles
flavorText: Two delicate golden bangles with moonstone inlays. They are inscribed with Jone and Jode respectively.
name: Alfiq Moonstone Bangles

title: Captain's Rain Slick
flavorText: When properly maintained with oil and beeswax, this waterproof cloak keeps its wearer dry even during the roughest storms.
name: Captain's Rain Slick

title: Boiling Blood Anthology
flavorText: A particularly salacious tome. This collection of erotic stories centers a moody vampire prince and his peasent born lover.
name: Boiling Blood Anthology

title: Blood Stained Quill
flavorText: It's unclear whether blood was used in place of ink or if the owner was merely in the middle of a meal while writing.
name: Blood Stained Quill

title: Lucky Gargoyle's Tooth
flavorText: While the line between minion and pet is admittedly blurry, this charm may have been crafted to remember a favored gargoyle.
name: Lucky Gargoyle's Tooth

title: Gilded Blood Spigot
flavorText: For vampiric entities that appreciate tidier meals, this blood stained tool can be used much like a mead barrel's spigot.
name: Gilded Blood Spigot

title: House Vraseth Goblet
flavorText: This chalice bears the signet of a powerful vampiric bloodline from the region around Iliac Bay. It's still slightly sticky.
name: House Vraseth Goblet

title: Spicy Nightshade Crisps
flavorText: A small satchel of crispy Nightshade petals. A particularly potent snack that would leave mortals numb if not outright deceased.
name: Spicy Nightshade Crisps

title: Horn of the Hunting Grounds
flavorText: Rumored to be blessed by Hircine himself, this horn's call shifts from a wolf's howl to a man's scream when the moon is full.
name: Horn of the Hunting Grounds

title: Beeswax Lip Balm
flavorText: This tin of soft, waxy balm is flavored with comberry and gives users' lips a dewy, kissable sheen.
name: Beeswax Lip Balm

title: Powdered Pearl Mouth Rinse
flavorText: Nobles of High Isle swear by this cloudy liquid as an aid for brighter, shinier teeth.
name: Powdered Pearl Mouth Rinse

title: Spring Coil Epilator
flavorText: This tightly-coiled steel spring yanks unwanted hair out by the root when rolled over skin. It's as painful as it sounds.
name: Spring Coil Epilator

title: Phoenix Lashes
flavorText: Made from the antennae of phoenix moths, these ember-inspired lashes give new life to the smokey eye look.
name: Phoenix Lashes

title: Satin Sleeping Bonnet
flavorText: A luxury item from the Imperial City, this sleek wrap keeps hair hydrated and silky for fuss-free styling in the morning.
name: Satin Sleeping Bonnet

title: Enchantment-Free Beard Booster
flavorText: This fragrant, nonmagic mix of wax and pigments comes with a small blending brush to make patchy beards appear naturally full.
name: Enchantment-Free Beard Booster

title: Wick Trimmer
flavorText: A specialized pair of foreceps used to trim the curled and burnt wick ends of candles in a shrine or temple.
name: Wick Trimmer

title: Candle Snuffer
flavorText: For when blowing out the flame is too much work.
name: Candle Snuffer

title: Steadfast Healer's Kit
flavorText: This modest satchel of healing supplies appears to have been blessed by a Resolute of Stendarr.
name: Steadfast Healer's Kit

title: Gavel of Julianos
flavorText: This weighty gavel is likely used to call to order impassioned debates within a temple of Julianos.
name: Gavel of Julianos

title: Dibellan Wax Warmer
flavorText: This decorative votive uses a small candle to warm a dish of wax or oil for use in some Dibellan worship activity.
name: Dibellan Wax Warmer

title: Mara's Union Memory Stones
flavorText: A pair of small stones embossed with the sigil of Mara. When one is squeezed, the other glows and pulses with warmth.
name: Mara's Union Memory Stones

title: Pony Guar Glass
flavorText: A small, stemmed glass perfect for sipping cordials and liquers.
name: Pony Guar Glass

title: Seaman's Tankard
flavorText: A sturdy, hooped, wooden tankard. The handle seems to be made of a metal mooring cleat.
name: Seaman's Tankard

title: Systres Cyclone Glass
flavorText: A tall, bulbous glass for mixed drinks typical of the Systres Archipelago.
name: Systres Cyclone Glass

title: All Flags Flagon
flavorText: An ornate vessel with design influence from every party in the All Flags Navy. Likely pilfered from All Flags Isle.
name: All Flags Flagon

title: Sea Travel Tea Service
flavorText: This tongue-twisting tea set is enchanted to stay affixed to the tray, no matter how one's ship is tossed on the waves.
name: Sea Travel Tea Service

title: Vastyr Bitters
flavorText: A small-batch aperitif of medicinal herbs originating from Vastyr in Galen. Highly aromatic, used to flavor mixed drinks.
name: Vastyr Bitters

title: Giant Squid Beak
flavorText: Someone either cut this sizeable beak from a giant squid itself, or pulled it from the stomach of something even bigger.
name: Giant Squid Beak

title: Serpent's Hollow Split Shot Set
flavorText: A container of slitted metal balls affixable to fishing line. Ideal for weighing down lines to catch bottom feeders.
name: Serpent's Hollow Split Shot Set

title: Gonfalon Lobster Pot
flavorText: It's a one-way trip for lobsters that go for the bait inside in this submersible wood and wire cage.
name: Gonfalon Lobster Pot

title: Bosun's Pipe
flavorText: Captains who use this shrill steel whistle to command attention of their crews are ten times more likely to be mutinied.
name: Bosun's Pipe

title: Writheleaf Fly Fishing Lure
flavorText: A fishing lure centered around druid-enchanted ivy. Squirms and writhes like a living thing.
name: Writheleaf Fly Fishing Lure

title: Dreadsail Flag Semaphore Set
flavorText: Signallers in the Dreadsail fleet use these short, colorful flags to convey messages between ships.
name: Dreadsail Flag Semaphore Set

title: Eldertide Clamshell Castanets
flavorText: These naturally lacquered clamshells make a hollow, percussive sound when clacked together.
name: Eldertide Clamshell Castanets

title: Quartermaster's Mouth Organ
flavorText: For something so small, this rectangular, pocket-sized instrument makes a big, harmonious sound.
name: Quartermaster's Mouth Organ

title: Faun Flute
flavorText: This simple flute crafted from water reeds and bound in twine is believed to have been made by the Fauns of High Isle.
name: Faun Flute

title: Battle Hymnals of the Daggerfall Covenant
flavorText: A compendium of battle songs collected by a Covenant soldier and sent to her sister at the Bards College in Solitude.
name: Battle Hymnals of the Daggerfall Covenant

title: Imperial Opera Glasses
flavorText: These lacquered binoculars saw many dramatized battles on the stages of the Capital City before real war came to Cyrodiil.
name: Imperial Opera Glasses

title: High Isle Concertina
flavorText: Skilled bards can make this obscure, Breton-made bellowing instrument feel like a full orchestra.
name: High Isle Concertina

title: Fish Glue
flavorText: A jar of glue chips derived from fish bones and skin, used primarily in binding and preserving manuscripts.
name: Fish Glue

title: Folding Rule
flavorText: Foldable tool used for measuring lengths in woodworking.
name: Folding Rule

title: Joiner's Mallet
flavorText: A heavy, sanded maple mallet used for all matter of pounding done in carpentry.
name: Joiner's Mallet

title: Mortise Chisel Set
flavorText: A carpenter's set of different-sized chisels. Good for the joints—woodworking joints, that is.
name: Mortise Chisel Set

title: Seafarer's Candle Mold
flavorText: A wooden mold for making candles in the shape of a ship's bell.
name: Seafarer's Candle Mold

title: Shipwright's Spirit Level
flavorText: The alchemical liquid inside this circular carpentry tool is enchanted to glow when aligned on a level surface.
name: Shipwright's Spirit Level

title: False Book Jacket
flavorText: A cover for a generic manners novel. Used to disguise the book covers of more salacious reading materials.
name: False Book Jacket

title: Galen Chapbook
flavorText: A short visitor's leaflet on the history of the Isle of Galen, with an obvious slant in favor of the Mornard family.
name: Galen Chapbook

title: Sapphire Tourney Poster
flavorText: A poster depicting the sigils of the three knightly orders that sponsor the Sapphire Tourney.
name: Sapphire Tourney Poster

title: The Lover's Guide to Birthsign Compatibility
flavorText: The anonymous author of this astrological account clearly got their heart broken by someone under the sign of the Steed.
name: The Lover's Guide to Birthsign Compatibility

title: Breton Braids for Breton Brides
flavorText: A visual guide to the complicated updos traditional to Breton high society. Sought out by those marrying into Breton families.
name: Breton Braids for Breton Brides

title: Cumberland Dynasty Ancestry Chart
flavorText: A family tree for the Cumberland family of Stormhaven, tracing back to the middle of the first era.
name: Cumberland Dynasty Ancestry Chart

title: Stonelore Ragamuffin Doll
flavorText: This crude rag doll's been repaired so many times there's no scrap of the original fabric remaining.
name: Stonelore Ragamuffin Doll

title: Cuddly Ursauk
flavorText: This ursauk's overstuffed belly and large eyes give it a friendly appearance.
name: Cuddly Ursauk

title: Forest Wraith Finger Puppet
flavorText: A small representation of the unsettling horned figure used to scare small children into staying away from the forests.
name: Forest Wraith Finger Puppet

title: Rough-Sewn Albatross Doll
flavorText: A large representation of an albatross given to the youngest knight aspirants in order to help them plan for their adventures.
name: Rough-Sewn Albatross Doll

title: Jester Marionette
flavorText: A colorfully dressed marionette that nobles use to keep the merriment of feast days alive in the weeks after the celebration.
name: Jester Marionette

title: Shining Knight
flavorText: A mounted knight with metal sword, shield, and armor. It does not bear the livery of any particular house.
name: Shining Knight

title: Stonelore Fiber Doily
flavorText: Many different strands of cut off fibers give this table runner a strange, ever-changing texture.
name: Stonelore Fiber Doily

title: Shawl of the Circles
flavorText: The druids weave three-sided knots into the pattern of this shawl.
name: Shawl of the Circles

title: Sailor's Wishing Pillow
flavorText: The inside of the pillowcase is embroidered with lines of prayers and hidden desires to return home safely.
name: Sailor's Wishing Pillow

title: House Mornard Banquet Table Runner
flavorText: A long, thin bolt of heavily decorated fabric which can span the entireity of a great feast table.
name: House Mornard Banquet Table Runner

title: Systres Heraldry Quilt
flavorText: A quilt made from the colors and coats of arms of all the noble houses on the Systres Archipelago.
name: Systres Heraldry Quilt

title: Mornard-Dufort Kerchief
flavorText: A handkerchief celebrating the unusual marriage between members of House Mornard and Dufort.
name: Mornard-Dufort Kerchief

title: Box of Depleted Ammonites
flavorText: These ammonites are dull and do not glow or shine with stored magicka.
name: Box of Depleted Ammonites

title: Stonelore Dousing Rod
flavorText: Stonelore Druids utilize this branch to locate and unearth the large slabs of rock used for their carvings.
name: Stonelore Dousing Rod

title: Faun Hoof Powder
flavorText: This container is tightly corked since powdered Faun's hoof is good for many potions but smells worse than rotting fish.
name: Faun Hoof Powder

title: Mages Make Do
flavorText: A spellbook containing instructions on how to substitute ingredients for many well known potions.
name: Mages Make Do

title: Y'ffre's Blessed Soil
flavorText: A sack of potting soil that is enchanted to help plants grow.
name: Y'ffre's Blessed Soil

title: Captain's Cleaning Flasks
flavorText: A series of water flasks that can sift salt from sea water and render it safe to drink. Very useful for staving off mutinies.
name: Captain's Cleaning Flasks

title: Seasalt Scrub
flavorText: A coarse paste made from large chunks of salt. Good for cleaning out infection and drying wounds.
name: Seasalt Scrub

title: Chewbark Fever Strips
flavorText: Slim slats of bark which help reduce a fever and allows the ill to fall into a restful slumber.
name: Chewbark Fever Strips

title: Stormsease Joint Cream
flavorText: Rubbing this balm on old wounds helps reduce their discomfort when the cold winds of a thunderstorm begin to blow.
name: Stormsease Joint Cream

title: Slithering Antivenom
flavorText: A vial of clear liquid that can quickly reverse the effect of four deadly snake venoms.
name: Slithering Antivenom

title: Systres Sunflower Oil
flavorText: A soothing oil which can ease digestive ailments and quiet irritated throats.
name: Systres Sunflower Oil

title: Spiderweb Bandages
flavorText: Bandages woven from spiderwebs. They're best when applied on deep wounds and keep out the worst infections.
name: Spiderweb Bandages

title: Bleeding Antler
flavorText: The mud caked around the bottom of this horn is a dark reddish color, giving it the appearance of bleeding.
name: Bleeding Antler

title: Engraved Femur
flavorText: The writing carved along the length of this bone insists that it's from a pig.
name: Engraved Femur

title: Pickled Eyestalks
flavorText: For a more authentic flavor, add kelp and a brine to the pickling liquid.
name: Pickled Eyestalks

title: Punctured Coin
flavorText: Sailors believe that these coins will help protect them from pirates while at sea. By the blood on this one, it didn't work.
name: Punctured Coin

title: Porcelain Offal Jar
flavorText: Miscellaneous organs preserved in an airtight container. The designs painted on the jar are pretty though.
name: Porcelain Offal Jar

title: Weeping Mermaid Doll
flavorText: Made from the hides of ten rare beasts, this mermaid appears to be crying for all the lives lost to its creation.
name: Weeping Mermaid Doll

title: All Flags Ship Kit
flavorText: A small kit of cheap woodens slats which can be assembled to resemble Admiral Bendu Olo's flagship.
name: All Flags Ship Kit

title: Ancestor Bust
flavorText: The bust of an unnamed ancestor. His mustache is littered with beads, possibly hinting at a sailor's lineage.
name: Ancestor Bust

title: Iron Knot Knight
flavorText: The knight's armor is a little dusty, but the filigrie along the sword clutched in the knight's hand is still visible.
name: Iron Knot Knight

title: Y'ffre's Tree
flavorText: Idol of a verdant tree, its intricately carved branches hint at great craftmanship.
name: Y'ffre's Tree

title: Nesting Bird Figurine
flavorText: A seabird sitting protectively over a clutch of alabaster eggs.
name: Nesting Bird Figurine

title: Y'ffre's Beard
flavorText: A square carving done in the traditional Stonelore style. An old man's wizened face is lovingly chisseled into the surface.
name: Y'ffre's Beard

title: Druid Cloak Clasp
flavorText: A bronze buckle in the twisted triangle shape of the three circles.
name: Druid Cloak Clasp

title: Iridescent Shell Bowls
flavorText: Decorative bowls made out of hollowed sea shells, the inside is awash with the blended hues of the sunrise.
name: Iridescent Shell Bowls

title: Preserved Flowers and Feathers
flavorText: Pressed flowers and feathers arranged in a stunning bouquet and preserved in lightly tinted amber.
name: Preserved Flowers and Feathers

title: Banners of the Disgraced House
flavorText: A box filled with banners from when House Mornard controlled the Systres Archipelago.
name: Banners of the Disgraced House

title: Weaver's Tapestry Sketch
flavorText: A drawing of an intricate tapestry created by a weaver before beginning on the larger project.
name: Weaver's Tapestry Sketch

title: The Ritual Star Charm
flavorText: Seven green beads that hang in the shape of the ritual constellation. The beads look as if someone rubbed them for good luck.
name: The Ritual Star Charm

title: Shipyard Silk Bedspread
flavorText: A fine silken bedcover supposedly given to Admiral Bendu Olo the night the All Flags Naval Base finished construction.
name: Shipyard Silk Bedspread

title: Jade and Ruby Runestones
flavorText: Divination stones passed from one court mage to the next. Despite the carved runes, these stones could be worth a fortune.
name: Jade and Ruby Runestones

title: Graht-oak Acorn
flavorText: A skilled greenspeaker could plan wondrous developments with this melon-sized acorn, if it doesn't roll off on its own first.
name: Graht-oak Acorn

title: Covenant Letter of Marque
flavorText: An official letter authorizing the holder to siege vessels flying under Dominion or Pact colors. Signed by High King Emeric.
name: Covenant Letter of Marque

title: Mournhold Roister's Club Stein
flavorText: Emblazoned with the tribute tri-card sigil, this clay stein is still stained with wine from the Flaming Nix.
name: Mournhold Roister's Club Stein

title: Hempen Tribute Play Mat
flavorText: This woven play mat has a few fanciful representations of Tribute Patrons painted onto the reeds.
name: Hempen Tribute Play Mat

title: Lion-Embossed Tribute Deck Box
flavorText: This lacqured box is scratched and scuffed, likely a safehold for a Covenant soldier's play decks.
name: Lion-Embossed Tribute Deck Box

title: Gold-flecked Prestige Beads
flavorText: Beads used to count prestige in a Tribute match nestle cozily within a velvet cloth bag.
name: Gold-flecked Prestige Beads

title: Pewter Tribute Card Frames
flavorText: These metal card frames are intended to add some heft (and protection) to your tribute deck.
name: Pewter Tribute Card Frames

title: Cherry Wood Prestige Counter
flavorText: A wooden disc with etched dials allows the dedicated Tribute player to keep track of their prestige count.
name: Cherry Wood Prestige Counter

title: Wispheart Totem Clue
flavorText: A riddle that allows you to discover an upgraded Tribute card. This clue is needed to acquire the upgrade.
name: Wispheart Totem Clue

title: Druid King Vestments Clue
flavorText: A riddle that allows you to discover an upgraded Tribute card. This clue is needed to acquire the upgrade.
name: Druid King Vestments Clue

flavorText: This is a standard house item.
name: Druidic Statue, Planter

flavorText: This is a large house item.
name: Druidic Sculpture, Sphere
